app.name: Dashboard Engine
manager.search.label: Search packs
manager.detail.empty: Select a pack to see its details.
manager.registry.label: Registry URL
manager.launcher.hint: Pins appear on any pack with a launcher component (drop one in via the editor). Your pins and recents are personal — they never leave this PC or enter a pack.
manager.assistant.speakAloud: Speak replies aloud (in the voice picked above)
manager.assistant.group.other: Other languages (reply + speak in that language)
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.label: Interface language
settings.language.help: Choose the interface language. Community translations added to the locales folder appear here automatically. Untranslated text falls back to English.
manager.settings.display.title: Display
manager.settings.display.help: Choose which monitor shows the animated wallpaper. It moves right away.
manager.settings.display.moved: Moved the wallpaper to the selected display.
manager.settings.startup.title: Startup
manager.settings.startup.autostart: Start Dashboard Engine when Windows starts
manager.settings.startup.autostartHint: The engine launches quietly to the tray when you sign in, so your desktop is already alive — no window to open.
manager.settings.startup.unsupported: Start-with-the-OS isn’t available on this platform.
manager.settings.voiceAlerts.title: Voice alerts
manager.settings.voiceAlerts.help: Your assistant voice announces when CPU, memory or disk run high, or the battery gets low. Needs a “System info” component with Live health alerts on, and speaks with the voice from Assistant → Voice.
manager.settings.performance.title: Performance
manager.settings.performance.help: The animated wallpaper pauses and throttles like Wallpaper Engine so it stays a good background citizen. These are the same controls as the tray’s Performance menu.
manager.settings.performance.pauseFullsc: Pause when a full-screen app covers the screen
manager.settings.bgMotion.title: Background motion
manager.settings.bgMotion.help: Scales the parallax and depth drift on layered pack backgrounds — turn it down, or off, if you find the movement distracting. It doesn’t affect performance.
manager.settings.weather.title: Weather
manager.settings.weather.help: Any pack whose weather has no location of its own uses this.
manager.settings.music.title: Background music
manager.settings.music.help: Play your own music on the desktop. Files stay on your PC and are never saved into a pack or shared — the wallpaper just plays them, looping through the list.
manager.settings.music.empty: No music added yet — add some audio files below.
manager.settings.help.title: Help
manager.settings.help.hint: If something goes wrong, the logs folder holds a diagnostic log (and any crash dumps) you can share when reporting a problem. It contains no personal data.
manager.settings.help.logsError: Could not open the logs folder.
manager.settings.about.title: About & licenses
manager.settings.about.help: Dashboard Engine includes open-source software and voices from other creators. The notice below lists them with their licenses and required attributions.
manager.settings.about.openError: Could not open the notices file.
manager.builder.title: New pack
manager.welcome.title: Welcome to Dashboard Engine
manager.welcome.lead: Your desktop is now a live dashboard — it renders straight onto the wallpaper, behind your icons. Here's what you can do from here.
manager.event.hint.timed: A desktop notification fires at the alert time (the engine runs in the tray).
manager.event.hint.untimed: Give the event a time to get a desktop notification.
manager.event.hint.repeating: Repeating events edit as a whole series.
